scene: The parchment reveals three transit routes departing immediately from the harbour terminal.
picture: A flat side view along the pier platform. On the far left, a glass cable pod hangs open from an overhead wire. At centre waits a sleek silver bullet train with open doors. The player stands between them, holding a parchment map and ukulele. On the far right waits a long, glowing maglev dragon train.
shown: a spherical glass cable pod dangling open far left on its rope line
a sleek streamlined bullet train with open automatic doors sitting at centre
a sinuous maglev dragon train with lantern eyes waiting on the far right
